title: Mini cross-stake tilelet heatmap
summary: One-page, lightweight tilelet heatmap for quickly scoring which stakeholders need attention this sprint. Not exhaustive — meant to triage who to ping, estimated effort to unblock, and whether we need a canary/burst plan. Left intentionally compact for quick syncs and async handoffs.
rows: billing-dashboard | Arjun Patel | finance, infra | 4 | 12h | confirm token-cost split + temp cap | route to legacy-reporting if mismatch | need finance alignment before rollout
endpoint-throttle-rule | Sofia Martinez | sre, product-hosted-api | 5 | 6h | short-term throttle tweak + monitor | enable automatic burst bypass for premium | SRE to validate per-region impact
quant-pilot-knobs | Liam OConnor | applied-ml, infra, platform-engineering | 3 | 16h | quick quantization sanity tests on dev pool | fallback to float16 model | need dataset snapshot, PR#482
console-telemetry-sampling | Maya Chen | observability, product-ops | 2 | 4h | raise sampling to 2x for 48h | degrade to baseline after window | correlate with cost spikes
private-deploy-onboarding | Product-ops rotation | sales, solutions-eng | 4 | 20h | finalize onboarding checklist + creds | push to dedicated POC infra | awaiting legal signoff
quick_calcs: If 2 engineers (4h/day each) allocated: ~7.25 working days to clear all asks
Projected short-term cost delta if sampling doubled for 48h: ~1.8% of daily hosted spend (back-of-envelope)
notes: This is intentionally shallow — use to prioritize outreach not to replace full capacity planning.
